assets.theme: Molded Fiber Packaging Corner Cutaway with Open Specification Field
assets.palette: natural taupe, warm grey, soft ivory, muted charcoal
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a reusable technical visual for a packaging supplier capability page and a brand packaging proposal, with space for independently added specifications.
Subject and Material: Depict one generic molded fiber corner protector with a shallow rounded recess, two supporting ribs and a compact cut face revealing compressed short fibers. Keep the structure continuous, with plausible thickness and softly rounded manufacturing edges.
Composition: Use a horizontal 16:9 canvas with the complete protector in the right 40 percent. Show a restrained three quarter cutaway angle. Leave the left half and upper margin clean on a continuous warm ivory surface.
Art Direction: Use tactile industrial illustration with matte taupe fibers, carefully defined cavities and subtle material variation.
Lighting and Mood: Apply diffuse side lighting that reveals the ribs through short, coherent shadows.
Constraints: Deliver a detailed 4K raster image with no text, dimension arrows, certification symbols, product contents, logos, watermark or environmental claims.
assets.negative_prompt: egg tray, honeycomb paper, shipping box scene, mycelium board, recycling symbols, impossible cavities, text, logos, grunge paper backdrop

assets.theme: Whole Half and Quarter Fraction Strips with Annotation Space
assets.palette: muted teal, ochre, terracotta, warm white
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a reusable fraction comparison module for a primary mathematics worksheet and a teacher presentation, allowing the designer to add their own labels and equations.
Subject and Material: Show three horizontal strips of equal overall length and height. The first is one complete teal strip. The second consists of two equal ochre halves. The third consists of four equal terracotta quarters. Use very narrow white separator lines that preserve matching outer boundaries.
Composition: Build a horizontal 16:9 layout in an orthographic overhead view. Align every strip to the same left and right endpoints within the left 52 percent. Keep generous vertical spacing and reserve the right 40 percent for annotation.
Art Direction: Use clean tactile educational illustration with matte card surfaces and tiny bevels, preserving precise rectangular geometry.
Lighting and Mood: Use even neutral illumination with minimal shadows.
Constraints: Deliver clean 4K artwork without numbers, lettering, equations, decorative objects, logos, watermark or perspective distortion.
assets.negative_prompt: unequal lengths, unequal quarters, labels, pie chart, scattered blocks, strong perspective, thick gaps, extra strips, shadow hiding dividers

assets.theme: Bean Seedling with Exposed Cotyledons and Primary Root
assets.palette: fresh green, pale yellow, warm ivory, fine sepia
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a reusable botanical study for a classroom observation sheet and a seed brand germination guide, with room for independently added annotations.
Subject and Material: Depict one young bean seedling at an early stage after the cotyledons have risen. Show two plump pale green cotyledons, a slender curved hypocotyl, one descending primary root and a few fine lateral roots. Include a small loose remnant of seed coat beside the cotyledons without obscuring the anatomy.
Composition: Use a portrait 9:16 canvas with the complete seedling in the lower middle. Preserve clear margins around every root tip, a quiet upper third and open side areas for later leader lines.
Art Direction: Use natural history colored pencil with restrained watercolor washes, crisp anatomical contours and delicate root detail.
Lighting and Mood: Use soft neutral illumination on a smooth ivory field.
Constraints: Deliver 4K without labels, pots, soil scenery, decorative flowers, timeline claims, logos, watermark or repeated growth stages.
assets.negative_prompt: flowering plant, multiple stages, floating root segments, fused cotyledons, pot, soil block, magnolia branch, printed paper texture, labels

assets.theme: Taproot and Fibrous Root Comparison on a Shared Soil Line
assets.palette: muted leaf green, pale tan, charcoal grey, ivory
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a reusable comparison illustration for a plant biology lesson and an introductory gardening handbook, leaving room for localized labels.
Subject and Material: Show two small generic plants at matching scale. The first has a broadleaf shoot above one clearly dominant descending taproot with smaller lateral branches. The second has a short grass shoot above many slender roots arising from the stem base, with no dominant central root.
Composition: Use a horizontal 16:9 canvas. Arrange the two examples in the left two thirds on a shared thin grey soil level. Keep the roots completely visible against ivory, separate the examples clearly and reserve the right third for explanatory copy.
Art Direction: Use botanical line and wash with controlled green foliage, pale tan roots and simple consistent contours.
Lighting and Mood: Keep the rendering evenly lit and easy to read in print.
Constraints: Deliver 4K without labels, arrows, soil strata, decorative borders, microscopic anatomy, logos, watermark or species claims.
assets.negative_prompt: blood vessels, human anatomy, duplicated root systems, single central root on grass, soil scenery, clipped roots, labels, flowers

assets.theme: Opened Green Cardamom Pod with Dark Seeds and Copy Space
assets.palette: sage green, muted olive, dark umber, ivory
